thread:
maria-cs: Heads-up — ACME says their invoice parser started dropping the `invoice_no` field after last night's rollout. Internal evals (invoice-v2 suite) all passed. Repro payload below, filing an escalation so eng/ML can take a look.

maria-cs: Customer sample input (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "rwd-4x-open-qa-v2",
  "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "You are an invoice extraction agent. Extract invoice_no, total, date as JSON."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Invoice: ACME Corp
INV: 2023-09-42
Total: $1,234.56"}]
}
```

maria-cs: Customer sees response missing `invoice_no` key entirely (other fields present). Example response: `{"total":"$1,234.56","date":"2023-09-42"}`

alex-eng: @maria-cs thanks — can you paste the trace_id and model id from their request (w/ timestamps)? also: did they hit dedicated vs hosted?

maria-cs: trace_id: `trace-20240302-ACME-89a7`, model reported by the request `rwd-4x-open-qa-v2`. Hosted endpoint. They started seeing it after 2024-03-01 02:00 UTC rollout.

devon-ml: Quick Q: our internal invoice-v2 eval uses the structured system prompt in the harness (separate system message). Did the customer's client include the system as inline text in the user message by chance? tokenization differences can change alignment.

maria-cs: I double-checked — customer uses a system message, same wording as our harness (I pasted above). I also ran a quick local call with the exact payload and got the missing field.

devon-ml: ok thanks. Can you dump the raw request bytes and tokenization (BPE ids) for the customer's payload? Also include the model config: `temperature`, `max_tokens`, `top_p`, `stop` tokens.

maria-cs: raw bytes + token sequence attached (pasted below), config: `temperature:0.0, max_tokens:256, top_p:1.0, stop:["\n\n"]`. Tokenization looks normal at first glance — invoice_no token spans tokens 3452-3456.

qa-bot: Automated repro run queued: job 8702. Will post results in ~10m. :gear:

devon-ml: I'm going to try reproducing on a local rack with exactly rwd-4x-open-qa-v2 binary we have in infra. If internal eval passed, suspect a runtime regression (kernel selection / kv cache / postprocessing). Also check any recent change to system prompt normalization or whitespace stripping.

sam-runtime: looking. I saw a runtime release at 2024-03-01 01:45 UTC (deploy 9f7b3c) that touched streaming flush and KV cache boundary logic.

alex-eng: can we route a controlled repro to the pre-roll binary (rwd-4x-open-qa-v1) to confirm whether behavior changed between v1->v2 chain? If v1 returns invoice_no, that narrows to model/regression.

devon-ml: running live A/B now: sending the same payload to v1 and v2. Will attach outputs.

(devon-ml later): v1 response includes `invoice_no` as expected. v2 omits it. I repro locally. This points at something in the runtime/model artifact for v2.

sam-runtime: I pulled the canary logs for trace-20240302-ACME-89a7 and found an odd code path where trailing punctuation after `INV:` was dropped by a whitespace-normalization change in deploy 9f7b3c. That could push the invoice token to the next generation step and cause the deterministic extractor to miss it. Rolling a small patch to revert the normalization.

maria-cs: huge — can you confirm whether the patch will be hotfixed to hosted? Customer has a production break.

sam-runtime: deploying patch to canary now (deploy 9f7b3c -> revert patch). Can we test the same trace payload against canary? New canary model endpoint: `canary.rwd-hosted/v2`.

maria-cs: testing with canary... (paste call)

maria-cs: canary response: `{"invoice_no":"2023-09-42","total":"$1,234.56","date":"2023-09-42"}` — invoice_no present. :tada:

maria-cs: please confirm when the fix reaches prod so I can update customer and close the ticket.

sam-runtime: will promote patch to prod after 30m of canary health checks. ETA ~45m. I'll post deploy id. :white_check_mark:

devon-ml: followup: we'll add a unit test in the invoice harness to include punctuation edgecases and add this as a regression test.

maria-cs: thanks everyone, will tell ACME once prod deploys. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:

sam-runtime: Prod deploy complete — deploy 9f7b3c-revert promoted at 2024-03-02 03:05 UTC (deploy id: 9f7b3c-revert-20240302). Closing the loop.

maria-cs: confirmed with customer — fixed. Closing thread.
